Doomscroll needs accessibility. Turn it on in Toy settings and in Android.
Install Instagram to use this toy.
Pip opens a lemonade stand. Tap the counter to order a glass, then tap the glass to take a sip.
Watch Pip paint a picture, stroke by stroke. Tap the finished painting to hear what he thinks of it.
Tap the ball to shoot and Pip kicks it back. First to three goals wins, or the match ends after 90 seconds.
Pop a sheet of 20 bubbles together. Tap any bubble, or watch Pip hop across the sheet and pop them himself.
Help Pip grow a flower. Tap the pot to water it, or watch him bring over his little watering can.
Pip watches and swipes through Instagram Reels for 30 seconds to 5 minutes. He won’t like reels from this button.
